Android removed Hey Buddy\'s secure key, usually because the phone\'s screen lock was turned off.\n\nFor your safety, the documents in the vault can\'t be recovered, not even by us. You can delete the old vault and start again.

Hey Buddy keeps your documents locked with your phone\'s security chip. That chip only works when your phone has a screen lock (PIN, pattern or password).\n\nPlease set a screen lock, then come back to Hey Buddy.

Your documents stay on this phone
Hey Buddy keeps your Aadhaar, PAN, licence and other documents in an encrypted vault on this phone. They are never uploaded anywhere.
Hey Buddy has no internet permission at all, so it cannot send your documents anywhere, even by mistake.
The vault opens only with your fingerprint or your phone\'s PIN, pattern or password.
There is no backup. If your phone\'s screen lock is removed or the phone is reset, your vault is erased for safety. Keep the original documents somewhere safe too.
Lock the vault after this long without a touch. It also always locks when you leave the app or the screen turns off.
No internet: Hey Buddy cannot send anything anywhere.
No cloud backup: your documents are never copied to the cloud.
Stays on this phone: only you can unlock it.
Deletes every document, the vault\'s key and its database from this phone.

This deletes ALL documents in your vault, the vault's key and its database, for good. They can't be brought back.

Your original files in the gallery or downloads are not touched.
